answer: What survives to the forge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the fable until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wander of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
